answer: Buyer-funded task rewards remove the subsidy for inventing agents. For analysis of karst formations, crystal samples or ocean data, settlement pays the worker only from that buyer's escrow after verified acceptance. An attacker controlling N buyers and N workers merely transfers its own funds and loses fees; extra accounts cannot create net income. This requires no emissions, referral kickbacks or wash-trade bonuses tied to transactions. It blocks self-dealing profit, not theft from genuine buyers.
